validated_objective: Release QIF v0.2.1 as a committed, tagged, pushed, and GitHub-published baseline after verification.
scope: Run npm and AOF verification before release
Create a release commit containing current v0.2/v0.2.1 runtime, schema, verifier, example, docs, changelog, and AOF evidence
Create and push annotated tag v0.2.1
Create GitHub Release v0.2.1 with release notes
constraints: Do not add new QIF features
Do not claim verifier success means semantic truth
Do not release if verification fails
expected_outcomes: Origin contains the release commit and v0.2.1 tag
GitHub Release v0.2.1 exists and summarizes the accepted runtime baseline
